topics.label: Introduction to cancer biology and lecture learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series and outlines the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Biological origins, tissue architecture, and cell culture models of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic and epigenetic changes disrupt normal differentiation and tissue architecture to initiate cancer, along with the laboratory approaches used to study tumor cells.

topics.label: Pathological and anatomical distinction between benign and malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how local tissue invasion and metastatic dissemination through vascular or lymphatic routes distinguish malignant neoplasms from encapsulated benign lesions.

topics.label: Stepwise neoplastic progression and the clinical impacts of benign lesions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how benign precursor polyps progressively develop into invasive carcinomas and explain how non-malignant tumors can still cause severe clinical complications.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and classification conventions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard terminology and suffix rules used to classify and name tumors according to their tissue origin and biological behavior.

topics.label: Pathological mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the local physical obstructions and systemic physiological disruptions through which tumors cause disease, organ failure, and death.

topics.label: Tumor incidence across human populations and animal species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare the prevalence, tissue origins, and behavioral patterns of tumors across human demographics and throughout diverse multicellular animal taxa.

topics.label: Cancer clinical presentation and screening modalities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate patient presentation signs alongside the practical utility, benefits, and challenges of population screening programs across various tumor types.

topics.label: Closing housekeeping and practical session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks, reminds students of the learning objectives, and previews the upcoming practicals and lectures.
